summary: Test-writing (red-phase) run for issue #39. Committed: solver parity corpus harness + seed fixture, OpenAPI generated-client contract tests + wire-contract snapshot fixture, and PaletteAPIClient migration-pinning behavior tests, plus LID docs mapping every acceptance criterion to its verification. Two intentional red guards fail by assertion until the upstream deliverables land: OpenAPIContractTests.testOpenAPIDocumentIsCommittedAtTheCanonicalPath (spec from viamin/color_matching#110) and SolverParityCorpusTests.testCanonicalUpstreamCorpusIsCommitted (corpus from viamin/color_matching#111). bin/lint exits 0; swift test could NOT be executed in this container (no Swift toolchain installed) — seed-corpus expectations were instead verified by an independent Python re-implementation of the scorer semantics (10/10 cases, including earliest-position tie-breaks and exclusions). Implementation run must run `cd ColorComposerCore && swift test` on a Swift host.
environment_blockers: No Swift toolchain in this container: `swift` not found; bin/lint prints 'Swift toolchain not available; skipping build and tests' and exits 0; swift test not executable here.

acceptance_criteria.description: Solver parity test target in ColorComposerCore tests loading the committed corpus and asserting WeightedSquaredErrorScorer selections match exactly, including ties.

references.detail: testCommittedCorpusFilesReplayWithExactParity replays every corpus JSON: selection equality, score within 1e-9, tie-marker verification (earliest-position wins), excluded_ids equality.
testCanonicalUpstreamCorpusIsCommitted fails by assertion until weighted-squared-error-corpus.json (viamin/color_matching#111) is committed.

10 hand-computed cases (doctest 0.205, exact match, earliest-position tie over lower id, symmetric tie, candidate/target exclusions, zero-weight ignore, weight scaling 11.0, lps+white selection). All 10 expectations independently re-verified in Python against the scorer's documented semantics.
